verdict.rationale: Warp ships a built-in AI agent (Warp Agent/Warp AI) that writes code, runs commands, explains errors, handles multi-step tasks, and supports multiple LLMs, all natively inside the terminal UI, with extensive first-party documentation and hands-on community confirmation (e.g. warp-comm-8, warp-comm-9 praising AI command generation as a daily-use feature). missing for 10: deeper independent verification of agent quality/reliability beyond mixed community reports on recent regressions.
